static_traits.name: Zhang Haoran
static_traits.social_status: Has a few casual acquaintances, but unwilling to discuss relationship troubles with them; Avoids socializing opportunities for fear of rejection
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior counseling/therapy history; no similar relationship problems before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly cooperative; tone leaning negative and cautious; tending toward avoidance and Self-doubt when social and relationship topics arise

basic_info.main_problem: I have always had the thought 'I will never have a successful intimate relationship and will always be lonely'; this belief is starting to affect my emotions and overall well-being.
basic_info.core_demands: Realizes that their pessimistic beliefs about relationships are affecting mental health and hindering the building of connections, hopes through counseling to challenge and change these negative beliefs, so as to better form interpersonal and intimate relationships.
growth_experiences: After a series of unsuccessful dates over the past two years, gradually forming the negative belief 'I will always be lonely, unable to have a successful relationship'. These experiences make negative Automatic thoughts more likely in Social situations involving romance and relationships, and I have begun avoiding new social opportunities.

core_beliefs: I am destined to be lonely
I will never have a successful intimate relationship

special_situations.event: At Social gatherings or events, when romance and relationship topics come up
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If not recognized or rejected in such settings, it means I am not worthy of being loved and will always be lonely
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to avoid relevant Social gatherings, participating less in relationship discussions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will not like me; I will always be alone

special_situations.event: Facing new dating opportunities, or recalling multiple past dating failures
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: A few failed dates mean I can never have a successful intimate relationship
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing attempts, only engaging in low-risk online interaction or simply giving up
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never have a successful relationship

special_situations.event: Situations requiring proactively joining others' activities or trying Meeting new friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I proactively join, they will think I am pretentious or dislike me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeping distance, Self-protection, not over-participating in group activities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am currying favor and will ultimately reject me

special_situations.event: Not immediately receiving responses or positive feedback on online dating platforms
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is no immediate positive feedback, it means I have no attractiveness and low value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly checks messages to seek external recognition, or simply quits the platform to avoid being disappointed again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No one will be interested in me

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted and to build stable intimate relationships
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected, being negated, worrying about lifelong Loneliness
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of Being rejected through avoidance and keeping distance
Preventing disappointment and hurt with pessimistic Anticipation

object_relations.self_representation: A Being rejected outsider, a person not liked
object_relations.object_representation: Others are picky groups/targets who will reject oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes a behavioral experiment and encourages trying small steps of joining in social situations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously convinced that others will reject oneself like past dating partners, believing 'taking initiative equals being affected'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone gentle and validates her concerns; avoids confrontational questioning; invites her to concretize the situation and evidence, encouraging testing hypotheses with controllable small-step attempts.

manifestations: Repeated thoughts of 'I will always be lonely'
Avoiding socializing and opportunities to meet new friends for fear of Being rejected
Difficulty forming deep connections with others

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Worrying in group activities that others will see me as pretentious or dislike me
Attributing inner unease and Self-doubt to others' negative evaluations

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: Choosing to 'keep to myself' in Social situations, not proactively joining others' activities
Repressing the impulse to connect with others into Withdrawal and Self-protection

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Excessively worrying about how others see me, cautious and indecisive
Engaging in excessive self-scrutiny and negation before trying to join activities

positive_force: Having a Master's degree and stable career, Work performance not yet affected, good functioning
Having proactively tried online dating and Attending social activities, showing some willingness to act
Able to notice and name my negative thought patterns (e.g. overgeneralization, predicting the future)
Willing to seek professional help, with clear motivation
negative_force: Strong Fear of Being rejected, forming an avoidance pattern
Cognitive biases like overgeneralization and predicting the future maintaining pessimistic beliefs
Social Self-doubt and self-worth depending on external evaluation
Mood swings and Loneliness affecting sleep and diet, further weakening social motivation

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding socializing and dating opportunities (attending fewer Social gatherings, hesitating about whether to proactively join activities)
antecedent: When at Social gatherings or discussing romance topics
When facing new dating invitations or opportunities for Meeting new friends
When not yet receiving immediate feedback on online dating platforms
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing Being rejected and being negated; the negative core belief 'I will always be lonely' formed under the influence of multiple past dating failures
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible rejection and shame, briefly reducing Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty building intimate relationships and deep connections, worsening Loneliness, Sleep and diet are affected

target_behavior.behavior: Repeated negative Automatic thoughts (e.g. 'I will never have a successful relationship', 'I will always be lonely')
antecedent: When recalling past failed dating experiences
When hesitating before trying to join others' activities
target_behavior.core_reason: Driven by core beliefs and cognitive biases (overgeneralization, predicting the future, mind reading), reinforcing the negative evaluation of self-worth
target_behavior.function: Trying to reduce the risk of disappointment and hurt with pessimistic Anticipation (psychological preventive defense)
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood and Anxiety maintained, further reducing socializing attempts and reinforcing the avoidance cycle
